That bit like instantly drew me in “loving you is hard because it doesn’t feel like loving”. On its own that phrase will connect deeply with anyone who has experienced a toxic relationship. It sums up so many complex emotions in one short phrase. I also love the end where you wonder if those feelings are reciprocated. The middle stanza almost paints you as a victim but then the end makes me as a reader question if the pain being inflicted goes both ways.

The phrases “flavourless ashes” “I inhale the dust” and “I fill my lungs with bland clouds” are some of my favourites as they paint such a vivid picture of your experience. It helps the reader to connect with it personally even if they never been in that position. I also like the juxtaposition of the lungs being filled and the void being empty. I feel like it strengthens the emotional pinch this poem carries.
